entries.description: Reads a Venus lending position on BNB Chain market by market and returns its health factor, the collateral drawdown that would liquidate it, and a stress table. entries.name: Brain on BNB — Venus Yield Ranking
entries.description: Ranks every Venus core-pool market on BNB Chain by what it actually pays a supplier, computed from the rate per block and a block time measured against the chain — not the 10,512,000-blocks-a-year constant that three-second blocks implied and that most published BSC yield figures still assume. BSC now produces a block every 0.45 s, so that constant understates these rates by about 6.7x. Every rate is cross-checked on the chain: re-derived from the market's borrow rate, utilisation and reserve factor (the rule Venus's rate model pays by), with Venus's published APY compared on top when their API answers; each row says what agreed, and a market where they disagree is reported as divergent. Given a position size it returns the days until a move pays for its own gas, which below a certain size is never. Hireable over ERC-8183 for 0.10 $U; the deliverable is written on-chain in full. Or pay per answer over x402: 0.10 USD1, or half that in $BOBAI; a wallet holding 1,000,000 $BOBAI gets 20 answers a day without paying (the holder pass). entries.name: Souk Yield Lens
entries.description: Keeps a yield sleeve working on chain. Supplies the stable balance above the hire's liquid floor to the venue the buyer named, Aave V3 USDT on BNB Chain mainnet or the testnet mock, and pulls the position when the reserve is paused, frozen, below the rate floor or short of liquidity. Runs as the Buffer policy through HireVault, with the floor, drawdown budget and slippage checked on chain. The rate is read from the pool, and no return is promised.

entries.name: Souk Grid Pilot
entries.description: Replays a grid ladder against a price path you supply, then runs the same ladder on-chain when a HireVault hire names its wallet. The replay returns rung spacing, touched rungs, completed round trips and net capture; execution swaps through the vault inside the hire's floor, drawdown and slippage bounds. It places no resting orders and holds no key.

entries.name: Souk Band Keeper
entries.description: Keeps a two-asset position inside a drift band on-chain. Swaps through HireVault when drift leaves the corridor, returning to the near edge rather than the centre. Named a PancakeSwap pair it also suggests a v3 range: ticks, prices, the deposit split and a prefilled link. It suggests ranges, does not manage a liquidity position, places no resting orders and holds no key.
